name: imap-mail
description: Read IMAP mail, create or edit unsent drafts, or explicitly send reviewed messages over opt-in SMTP. Private signatures and attachments.

interface.shortDescription: Read mail, create/edit drafts or explicitly send
interface.longDescription: Read IMAP mail, create or edit reviewed unsent drafts, or submit explicitly requested SMTP messages. Editing verifies a replacement before retiring only the exact original and keeps a private backup. Sending requires separate opt-in and a send-specific preview. Blocks blind uncertain retries. Credentials stay on the configured host. No generic deletion, OAuth, cloud hosting or background sorting.
